texts.li: {A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} how to come up on an animal slowly, from the side, talking all the while.
{B_nameDef} followed at {A_nameDef}'s heels asking questions until {B_pronoun} knew every animal's name and most of their bad habits.
{A_nameDef} let {B_nameDef} hold a lead rope, and {B_nameDef} gripped it in both hands and hardly breathed.
{B_nameDef} dropped what {B_pronoun} was doing to help {A_nameDef} turn back a few straying animals, and they were both laughing by the end.
{B_nameDef} lent {A_nameDef} a hand at feeding time and stayed to learn which animal gets fed first, and why.
{B_nameDef} held a nervous animal still while {A_nameDef} looked it over, and came away muddy and properly thanked.
